acceptance_limits: This resource batch executes no JVM oracle, native bridge, Cargo or target machine code.
New thirteen resource profiles require owned per-profile oracle/native comparison before backend acceptance.
Pilot native validation is parent-reported external evidence; original pilot records remain historical.
No loader, decompiler, benchmark or complete architecture-parity acceptance is implied.

admission_history.historical_closure_policy: Original ldefs are byte-identical; sibling SLA, pspec, compiler specs, dwarf maps and manual indexes retained. Only three selected profiles admitted; sibling variants are dependencies, not accepted profiles.
historical_acceptance_limits: No JVM oracle run or processor-discovery acceptance claim.
No native-loader, benchmark, decompiler-success or architecture-parity claim.
No compiler, installer, commercial executable, firmware or target execution included.
admission_history.provenance_limit: New generator source hashes belong to this extension attempt, not the historical pilot.

closure_hash_format: SHA256 of sorted entries: u64le(path UTF-8 length), path, u64le(file length), file bytes
